_about: Known data-check errors caused by the filing itself, not by this code. Each entry: ticker -> check id -> reason. The data-checks test fails on any error not listed here, and on any entry that no longer occurs (so the list cannot rot).

APA.missing-core: APA tags revenue only by product (oil, gas, NGL) with dimensions; the company-level revenue total is not in SEC company facts.

FOX.market-cap: Nasdaq's market caps for Fox's two share classes (FOX and FOXA) imply about 570M shares; Fox has about 430M Class A and Class B shares combined (diluted weighted shares in its 10-Q), so the Nasdaq figure is off, not the share count. FOXA sits just under the 25% limit and may need the same entry.

LHX.missing-core: L3Harris tagged full-year FY2025 revenue ($21.9B) with a start date of 2025-10-04, so it reads as a quarter.
